prompt: make me a habit tracker web app. i want to add habits, tick them off each day and see my streaks. single index.html file, and it should work on my phone too
assertions: The page has no horizontal overflow when rendered at 375px, 768px and 1440px wide.
Every piece of visible text meets WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text) against its background.
The rendered page uses at most 8 distinct font sizes.
The rendered page uses at most 4 distinct corner radii.
Every element reached by pressing Tab shows a visible focus style.
No interactive element is smaller than 24×24px, and at 375px wide no button or control is under 40px in its tappable dimension.
The page has a lang attribute, a viewport meta tag, exactly one visible h1, a main landmark, and no skipped heading levels.
Every form field has a label and every button or link has an accessible name.
The page loads with no console errors and no failed network requests.
